content.overview: IDA s. 10 — Reference of disputes to Boards, Courts or Tribunals (IDA s. 10). Complete Labour treatise with statutory deconstruction, examples, verified authorities, forum analysis and chamber drafting.
content.study:
Topic at a glance
CURRENT-LAW UPGRADE — The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 is in force from 21 November 2025. The old IDA s. 10 reference framework must not be copied mechanically into current advice: current dispute resolution is principally structured through IR Code ss. 42, 53–55, with conciliation, Tribunal adjudication and National Industrial Tribunal routes. State the applicable regime and procedural stage before advising on reference, maintainability or limitation.

IDA s. 10 — Reference of disputes to Boards, Courts or Tribunals (IDA s. 10) is a registered section in Labour & Industrial Law. IDA s. 10 — Reference of disputes to Boards, Courts or Tribunals (IDA s. 10) is governed by Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (in force from 21 November 2025); Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 and other earlier enactments are historical/concordance sources where the applicable transition regime requires them. identify the statute actually in force for the dispute, the date of termination or wage liability, the appropriate Government and the conciliation or reference stage.

Provenance, purpose and doctrinal foundation
The topic exists to organise a legally enforceable rule, doctrine or professional procedure. Read the statutory text, constitutional setting, institutional purpose and binding authorities together.
